objects.name: the lip
objects.examine: A lip of concrete, knee high. It is all there is.

objects.name: the top edge
objects.examine: The top of the tower. It's closer than the ground.

objects.name: the map on the wall
objects.examine: A map of the city. The tower is marked twice.

objects.name: the other tower
objects.examine: The other tower. Every window lit. Nobody in any of them.

objects.name: a pigeon
examine: It can leave whenever it likes.

objects.name: a paper cup
examine: Someone's coffee. Someone else sat here.

objects.name: the capsule
examine: Metal. A broken parachute. Coming down fast.
If it explodes we all get sick.

objects.name: the dog
examine: A little Nordic sweater. Someone dressed it for the weather.
It isn't struggling. It's just going down.

variants.text: It's fine if you don't look down.
You can see the whole city. Most of it.

say.text: If it explodes, we all get sick.
It hit the top of the tower. That slowed it down.
A dog, in a little Nordic sweater.
Someone dressed it for the weather.
Okay. I'm closer. I'll go first.
He grabs my arm, and I wake up.
